messages:
maria: T-8m quiet — final stillness check for #prod-change-window. Any last-minute hotfixs/exemptions? Please @mention if you need an exemption.

sam: small docs-only changelog tweak (typo in release notes). low risk, no code. requesting quick exemption.

lee: are you changing any config or model pins? if not, low risk. share PR link.

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/release-notes/pull/482 — just text. no deploy, CI will run.

anj: Thanks. docs-only => exempt. Sam keep an eye on CI failure alerts. :eyes: 

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary warmup started for release/2026-03-21. Targets: llm-proxy v3.2.4 -> v3.2.5. Canary=10% (10 instances).

oncall-kim: rollout metrics baseline: latency p95 target 120ms. will watch traces dashboard. if p95 >200ms for 3m, we abort.

deploy-bot: canary-check: smoke GET /health returned 200 from 10/10 instances. tail logs: no OOMs. /metrics ingest stable.

lee: running quick k8s check: ```kubectl rollout status deployment/llm-proxy -n prod --watch``` all replicas ready.

sam: good. CI passed for PR. merging now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: PR merged by sam. Initiating canary traffic shift -> 25%.

maria: note: documentation update won't change runtime. Proceeding with canary -> full at +5m unless we see regressions.

oncall-kim: observability note: spike alert channel on. ping me immediately if errors >1%.

deploy-bot: canary-update: traffic at 25%. health checks green. Checks: traces ok, error-rate 0.04%.

lee: SLO check: cost/runtime stable. no KV cache thrash.

anj: minor question: do we need to pin model-version for this rollout? current routing uses redwood:open-llama-13b:v4. no change.

sam: no pin changes. just release-notes. Confirm go/no-go?

maria: :thumbsup: go for rollout. @deploy-bot increase to 100% over next 2m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: gradual shift to 100% started. ETA ~2m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout complete. all checks green. Release window closed. Release notes deployed: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-21

oncall-kim: closing stillness: all good. I'll keep a 30m watch. :white_check_mark:

sam: ty all. will monitor nightly logs.
